_note: Sona Comstar reports one segment ('Mobility components, systems and sub-systems') and does not disclose revenue by product or business unit ('we don't report segment-wise or BU-wise revenue', CEO, Q3FY26 call). What it does disclose every quarter: BEV revenue and its share of automotive product revenue, the net order book, EV programmes and mix pies. Sales/EBITDA/PAT here are Screener's as-reported consolidated figures (company revenue includes a small net forex gain that Screener books in other income). Railway FY26 is our estimate (see railwayFY26). Q1FY25-Q3FY25 BEV revenue is derived from the year-on-year growth rates the company gave for Q2FY26, H1FY26 and Q3FY26 (marked derived; the FY25 sum is within Rs2 cr of the reported Rs1,223.5 cr).
src: Q1FY26-Q1FY27 presentations and call transcripts; AR FY26 pp.24-41; Q4FY26 presentation slides 9-16; Screener.in (as reported)

railwayFY26._why: Not disclosed. Bounds: (a) the business did Rs912.8 cr in FY25 under Escorts Kubota (AR FY25); ten months at that rate = Rs761 cr; (b) non-automotive revenue rose from 9% (FY25, ~Rs320 cr, off-highway) to 31% of FY26 revenue (~Rs1,387 cr) 'driven by the railway acquisition and off-highway growth' (AR FY26): with off-highway up 15-30%, railway = Rs970-1,020 cr. (c) Total revenue grew 26% while BEV fell 6% and management called the year 'tough': ex-railway revenue roughly flat implies ~Rs900 cr. We use Rs900 cr (~Rs90 cr a month), i.e. ~Rs1,080 cr annualised, +18% on FY25.
